scientific_integrity: Proof is self-contained with explicit all-domain structural induction; exhaustive finite checks are corroborative only. Primary published monadic support-normal form and existing union-closed enumerations are credited. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Purely unary signature, no equality/constants, nonempty structures; does not settle arbitrary relational equality-free cases; earlier monadic realised-support normal form is known. Rank-two optimality is for the restricted universal-outer grammar, not unrestricted FO. Historical priority may be partly subsumed by older semilattice/monadic preservation literature.
title: Disjoint-union preservation in equality-free monadic first-order logic: a canonical rank-two normal form
